article.headline: Davis leads Washington against Indiana after 44-point game
article.description: Washington Wizards (4-7, 10th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (3-8, 11th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Davis leads Washington against Indiana after 44-point game
article.linkText: Davis leads Washington against Indiana after 44-point game
article.story: Washington Wizards (4-7, 10th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (3-8, 11th in the Eastern Conference) Indianapolis; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Washington visits the Indiana Pacers after Anthony Davis scored 44 points in the Wizards' 122-111 loss to the Detroit Pistons. Indiana finished 19-63 overall and 15-37 in Eastern Conference action a season ago. The Pacers gave up 120.4 points per game while committing 20.9 fouls last season. Washington went 17-65 overall and 11-41 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Wizards allowed opponents to score 124.9 points per game and shoot 48.8% from the field last season. INJURIES: Pacers: Tyrese Haliburton: out (hamstring), T.J. McConnell: day to day (hamstring), Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl). Wizards: Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Justin Champagnie: out (foot), Bilal Coulibaly: out (hand), Reece Beekman: out (shoulder). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
